## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need to update the system requirements documentation for Plone, specifically regarding the Node Version Manager (NVM). The current documentation references an outdated version, and contributors are discussing ways to automate updates using scripts.

## What needs to be done
The documentation at [current system requirements](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/get-started/system-requirements.html#nvm) needs to reflect the latest NVM version (0.40.8) and any relevant Node.js requirements (currently set at `node>=22.22.0`). Consideration is being given to integrating a script that checks for the latest GitHub release dynamically.

## Helpful background
A script is being developed to fetch the latest NVM release from GitHub. Discussion points include potential implementation in the documentation's configuration file (`docs/conf.py`), though there are concerns about compatibility with the MyST format used for documentation.

## Good first steps
1. Review the system requirements documentation to identify all instances of outdated version numbers.
2. Familiarize yourself with the NVM and Node.js requirements.
3. Explore the Python script shared by contributors to understand its logic for fetching version information.
4. Consider setting up a local development environment to test your changes and check how documentation builds. If needed, reach out in the comments for assistance.
